comfy: Loopback-only fixed seven-node See-through graph; upload owned PNG asset; auto_download false; durable scoped receipt ledger; bounded object_info/history/queue and job-namespaced image requests. No global interrupt, arbitrary graph or renderer filesystem paths.
rife: Optional host-owned executable/model configuration; owned bounded PNG endpoints; fraction/GPU bounded; fixed original CLI arguments and no shell; timeout/cancellation waits for exit before temp cleanup. Result decoded and reimported as scoped asset.
verification: Actual isolated loopback HTTP fixture upload/submit/history/recover/output and foreign receipt rejection; real controlled Node subprocess verifies fixed RIFE args/output/cleanup. No user ComfyUI instance, weights download or GPU inference exercised.
limits: Host must explicitly configure RIFE executable/model paths. No GPU/model quality verification. UI bridge must translate original dataURLs into storeImage grants and assetRef outputs back into preview URLs/dataURLs.
